issues.title: List Platform Engineering Center as Primary Org
issues.description:
As a user from the Platform Engineering Center who needs to submit a support request through the Quick Submit Form, I want to see Platform Engineering Center and subordinate units listed as options when creating a support request.

---

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- When a user on the Quick Submit Form opens the "Primary Organization" selection list, they see "Platform Engineering Center" as an option
- When a user selects "Platform Engineering Center" as the primary organization and opens the "Secondary Organization" selection list, the list will be empty
- When a submits the form using "Platform Engineering Center" as the Primary Organization, a ticket will be created in Service Now with "Platform Engineering Center" as the organization
